title: Expensio crashes when exporting a report to PDF
body:
Since this morning's update, Expensio closes without any error when I export an expense report to PDF.

Steps:
1. Open any submitted report (I tried ER-55812 and ER-55790)
2. Click Export > PDF
3. The window freezes for ~5 seconds and then the app closes

Everyone in Accounts Payable hits this, I checked with three colleagues. We can still export to CSV as a workaround, but auditors need the PDFs for the month-end close.

Expensio version shown in Help > About: 4.12.0
